description: Transforms list items into grouped radio options.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible accessible group label; no fieldset is created.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Radio group name used on generated inputs.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: 1-based index of the checked item (`""` for no selection).

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Resets selected item to the initial value.

events.name: tp-radio-list-change
events.description: Emitted when selected value changes (`detail: { value, label }`).

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-radio-list>` element implements the <tp-icon name="radio-list" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Radio list functionality: transforms list items into grouped radio options.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Option | Click to select one option and replace the previous selection. |
| Hover | Highlights an enabled option without changing its selection. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Enter or leave the group. |
| Arrow keys | Move and select among enabled radio options. |
| Space | Select the focused option. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
